rollback_evidence: xe static routing (XE-M026), measured on IOL XE 17.18.2 (router) in the virtual topology. Key: [vrf:<name>:]<network>/<length> in the canonical form (IPv6 lower case, compressed). Lines: 'ip route [vrf V] NET MASK HOP [DISTANCE]' and 'ipv6 route [vrf V] PREFIX HOP [DISTANCE]' (accepted without ipv6 unicast-routing); the same next hop with another distance replaces the route, a new next hop is added before 'no... OLD-HOP' removes the old route; delete is 'no... HOP'. One next hop per destination: a destination with a second next hop (ECMP or floating route), an interface next hop or a further option (name, tag, permanent, track) is outside the profile and refused. The safeguard is the revert timer of the interface profile (configure terminal revert timer, configure confirm; an expired timer replaces the whole running configuration with the archive). Refused before any write: default routes, a destination that overlaps the management interface subnet or the SSH client address in the management VRF (show tcp brief, show ip interface brief), an undefined VRF or a VRF without the address family, a management VRF. The check account (privilege 1) reads show ip static route [vrf V] and show ipv6 static [vrf V].
